subject: Two different CC mice - same genotype

messages.author: af42cac4f04a08e8
messages.subject: Two different CC mice - same genotype
parts:
Dear Karl,

I wanted to ask regarding CC mice QTL analysis.
In our data, We want to include two lines with the same genotype but grown in different environments.

I wanted to ask if it's ok to repeat one line genotype again with a different name or if I need to change the code and use functions for expanding probs and kinship matrices?

Thanks so much for your help and support 

Best,

Kareem

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Two different CC mice - same genotype
parts:
You can include the genotype repeated if you want, but you will need to give it a different ID. The IDs for the genotypes need to be unique.

Alternatively, include the trait data for the second environment as additional phenotypes.

karl
